name: Lab-XCT Technique-Aligned Protocol Profile (labxctTAPP)
abstract: Laboratory X-ray computed tomography (polychromatic cone-beam) extension of the base TAPP definition. Adds XCT protocol-level acquisition/processing defaults as top-level ada: properties and an ada:methodParameters vocabulary of session-adjustable parameter templates. XCT has no per-element analyte axis, so no analyteTemplate is defined. Vocabularies and parameter templates ship as separate files under vocab/ and parameterTemplates/.
